versions.changelog:
- Clarified safety policy to specify that the --insecure flag only relaxes TLS validation per request and does not affect global Node TLS settings.
- No functional changes or new features; documentation updated for clearer guidance on security options.

A Node.js skill for OpenClaw that provides EWS (SOAP) operations against on‑prem Exchange Server 2016 CU21 orLater. It supports mail, folders, and calendar/meeting workflows with explicit write confirmations.
